title: Selecting the Glass Service: Auto Glass Services Tier Entry and Repair-or-Replace Guide
content:
Technical selection guide for **Auto Glass Services** at Crestline Collision & Glass. It sets when a chip is repaired rather than the windshield replaced, which tier a windshield replacement takes, what glass part type the Premium Feature tier uses, what an insurance glass claim job carries when scheduled, and the price basis and glass ordering lead of a job.

## 1. Governing text

> A chip is repaired rather than the windshield replaced when the chips number no more than the tier's maximum chips per repair, each is within the tier's largest repairable chip diameter, any crack is within the tier's longest repairable crack length, and the damage lies outside the driver's critical viewing area (repair in the driver's critical viewing area is not allowed on any tier). A windshield replacement takes Windshield Replacement when the vehicle's ADAS package is none, Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement when it is any other value, and Premium Feature Windshield Replacement when the glass has a head-up display, acoustic interlayer or heating that the lower tiers do not support (the tiers' head-up display, acoustic interlayer and heated glass fitment); Premium Feature glass is always oem (original-equipment glass only). An insurance glass claim job on a tier whose claim-number-at-scheduling setting is true carries the insurer's glass claim or referral number when scheduled. Glass and labor are priced on the tier's price basis; replacement jobs order their glass the tier's glass ordering lead in business days ahead.

The limits, fitment settings, claim-number setting, price basis and ordering lead named above are the figures set for each Auto Glass Services tier.

## 2. Entry to each tier

| Tier | Entry |
|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | damage: up to the tier's chip count, each within the chip diameter limit, cracks within the crack length limit, outside the driver's critical viewing area |
| Side Glass Replacement | glass: door, vent or quarter glass |
| Rear Glass Replacement | glass: back glass, heated or not |
| Windshield Replacement | glass: windshield on a vehicle whose ADAS package is none |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | glass: windshield carrying a forward camera bracket (ADAS package other than none), without head-up display |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | glass: windshield with head-up display, acoustic interlayer or heated wiper park area |

## 3. Repairing a chip: the four conditions

All four must hold for the chip to be repaired rather than the windshield replaced:

1. the number of chips is no more than the tier's maximum chips per repair;
2. each chip is within the tier's largest repairable chip diameter;
3. any crack is within the tier's longest repairable crack length;
4. the damage lies outside the driver's critical viewing area.

Damage inside the driver's critical viewing area fails condition 4 on every tier, since no tier allows repair there.

## 4. Choosing the windshield replacement tier

| The windshield | The vehicle's ADAS package | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| has none of head-up display, acoustic interlayer or heating | none | Windshield Replacement |
| has none of head-up display, acoustic interlayer or heating | any value other than none (a forward camera bracket) | Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement |
| has a head-up display | any | Premium Feature Windshield Replacement, glass always original-equipment |

## 5. Claim number when scheduling an insurance glass claim job

On a tier whose claim-number-at-scheduling setting is true, an insurance glass claim job carries the insurer's glass claim or referral number when it is scheduled. The number is the one stated by the caller, recorded verbatim, and goes with the insurer account named on the job. The condition is met before the job is scheduled.

## 6. Hypothetical cases

- *Case A.* A windshield has one chip within the chip diameter limit, no crack, and the chip sits outside the driver's critical viewing area: all four conditions hold, and the chip is repaired.
- *Case B.* The same chip sits inside the driver's critical viewing area: condition 4 fails, so the chip-repair conditions are not all met.
- *Case C.* A windshield with a head-up display on a vehicle with a forward camera: Premium Feature Windshield Replacement, with original-equipment glass.
- *Case D.* A shattered back window, heated: Rear Glass Replacement.
